- This "yellow back" pattern (yellowing on abaxial/lower surface, green on adaxial/upper surface) is the classic hallmark of **Yellow Leaf disease** (caused by Sugarcane yellow leaf virus - SCYLV)
- A small orange-red spot is visible within the yellow zone

**Reasoning:**
- Yellow Leaf disease is characterized precisely by this midrib yellowing on the lower leaf surface while the upper stays green
- Leaf Scald would show more scorched/white streaks
- Yellow Spot would show discrete isolated spots on green tissue
- Streak Mosaic would show mosaic/streaking patterns throughout the blade
- The "split" appearance — green top, yellow bottom/midrib — is the defining diagnostic feature of Yellow Leaf
